description: Automatic transfer switch controller (3xx family), GenComm Modbus protocol. S1 and S2 are the two supplies; Load is the switched output
source: Deep Sea Electronics, "GenComm standard for use with generating set control equipment" v2.272 (2025-07-21): sections 8.1 (sentinels) and 10 (pages 3, 4, 6, 7, 16, 154, 170, 171, 180, 190)
notes: DSE335 automatic transfer switch controller, GenComm protocol.
Address = page * 256 + offset. Pages 6, 7, 154, 170, 171, 180 and 190 use the
3xx / 335 layouts. Expansion module rows read as unimplemented when no module
Checked on a real DSE335 (RS485, 9600 8N2) on 2026-10-13: status, battery,
S1 voltages and frequency, phase rotation and clock read correctly.

system_control.0x8B787487: Select Auto with manual restore mode
system_control.0x8B797486: Start engine if in manual or test modes
system_control.0x8B82747D: Scroll through mode selections (mode button on 330/331/334/335)
system_control.0x8B94746B: Telemetry start if in auto mode
system_control.0x8B95746A: Cancel telemetry start in auto mode
system_control.0x8B9A7465: Reset the maintenance alarm 1 due times
system_control.0x8B9D7462: Reset the maintenance alarm 2 due times
system_control.0x8B9E7461: Reset the maintenance alarm 3 due times
system_control.0x8BA2745D: Start data logging (temporarily overrides the module state)
system_control.0x8BA3745C: Stop data logging (temporarily overrides the module state)
system_control.0x8BA4745B: Erase all data log files internal to the module (NOT on USB)
system_control.0x8BA5745A: Force USB drive to stop logging, ready to eject
system_control.0x8BBF7440: Battery Charger Select Alternative Charging Voltage
system_control.0x8BC87437: Battery Charger Auxiliary Select Alternative Charging Voltage
system_control.0x8BCB7434: Battery Charger Max Current Mode Timed
system_control.0x8BCC7433: Battery Charger max Current Mode Manual
system_control.0x8BD3742C: Remote Mains Fail Toggle (on then off, leaving the alarm latched but able to be reset)
system_control.0x8BDB7424: Battery Charger Stop Charging Out 1 and Out 2
system_control.0x8BE1741E: Switch to Multi Set platform (G8600 only)
system_control.0x8BE2741D: Switch to Single Set platform (G8600 only)
system_control.0x8BE3741C: Switch to Mains Parallel platform (G8600 or G8660)
system_control.0x8BE4741B: Switch to Group Controller platform (G8600 or G8660)
